text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
The second crown of the autumn shines atop 
Zenno Rob Roy's head. She magnificently 
achieved consecutive victories in the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn) and the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the "Arima Kinen." Just one 
step away from becoming the second in 
history to achieve this feat. All that 
remains is to charge fiercely ahead.
